title: Implement the observer pattern in Rust
description: Implement a Subject that holds subscribers (Box<dyn Fn(i32)>) and notifies them all when notify() is called.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Subject in src/lib.rs:
- Field: `subscribers: Vec<Box<dyn Fn(i32)>>`
- `new()`: Subject { subscribers: Vec::new() }
- `subscribe(f)`: self.subscribers.push(Box::new(f))
- `notify(value)`: for each sub in &self.subscribers { sub(value) }
- `subscriber_count()`: self.subscribers.len()
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
